subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which pair of letters will be on the opposite faces?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b10ba3b554d46e0e4d6ceaaa1ae9b644638b9b214a610b2d323d5243ad3d6b0f.png]
solution:
In the cube formed by the given sheet, Opposite faces are

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8d8764c12a29f795bf2c173fb6bff90dbea6f55805b8b4cddefce3644d5907.png] 

P will be opposite to Q

S will be opposite to T

And, U will be opposite to R.

So, Among the given options **S and T** are opposite face of the formed cube.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
